patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: which states have Councils, Council composition fractions (EXCEPT form), officers of Assembly, Article range 168-212
Recurring traps: 1/3-1/12-1/12-1/3-1/6 shares, Speaker resigns to Deputy Speaker, Speaker does not preside during own removal, Council only delays (no joint sitting)
AP tilt: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 caps AP Council at 50; AP Council abolished 1985, revived 2007
Art. 169 process: Assembly special majority, Parliament simple majority, not an Art. 368 amendment
App leans on UPSC-style multi-statement / 'how many correct' and match formats far more than APPSC's direct single-fact questions
